Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseRegula: 根據您鍛鍊的熟練度加成
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseOffset: 設置為 0 來設定為線性成長率
Sandbox_FWOFitness_currentExerciseRate_t: 線性成長的斜率 (數值越高=加成越高)(若偏移量不為 0 則同樣影響負面成長率)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_AverageExerciseRegula: 根據您所有鍛鍊的平均熟練度獲得加成
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExercise_tool: 依鍛鍊間隔來獲得經驗加成 (間隔 8 小時或肌肉痠痛緩解後)，體格及力量的加成分開計算
Sandbox_FWOFitness_SpaceOutExerciseNegat: 上次運動後太快再次運動時套用的減益
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonus_tooltip: 當您有肌肉痠痛時獲得負面經驗加成，休息後重新獲得加成 (肌肉痠痛緩解後)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_RestedBonusNegative_t: 有肌肉痠痛時套用的減益
Sandbox_FWOFitness_XPMultiplier: 其餘可選經驗加成基數
Sandbox_FWOFitness_XPMultiplier_tooltip: 整體經驗加成 (影響所有鍛鍊，建議為小數值)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_PassiveMultiplier: 被動經驗加成 (鍛鍊以外活動)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_PassiveMultiplier_too: 套用於運動以外任何能夠獲得力量及體格經驗的活動。例如：進戰/奔跑... (0 = 無被動加成)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_BoredomMultiplier_too: 調整無聊狀態的負面經驗加成 (0 = 關閉)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_UnhappynessMultiplier: 調整不開心狀態的負面經驗加成 (0 = 關閉)
Sandbox_FWOFitness_KeepBagsOn_tooltip: 運動期間保持背包和袋子裝備
Sandbox_FWOFitness_DropBags_tooltip: 為運動卸下背包時將袋子丟到地上
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_StrengthXPMu: Multiplier for strength XP gained from treadmill and benchpress
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_SprintingXPM: Multiplier for sprinting XP gained from treadmill use
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_HeatMultipli: Multiplier for body heat generated during exercise (0 = no heat, 1 = normal, 2 = double heat)
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_ThirstMultip: Multiplier for thirst generated during exercise (0 = no thirst, 1 = normal, 2 = double thirst)
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_TreadmillDro: Drop removed bags on the floor when unequipped for treadmill use
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_BenchpressDr: Drop removed bags on the floor when unequipped for benchpress use
Sandbox_FWOWorkingTreadmill_BenchTreadKe: Keep backpacks and bags equipped during exercise
